signs.meaning: A greeting used when meeting someone.
signs.hand_position: Hand open, fingers spread, thumb extended. Hand at side of forehead.
signs.movement: Move hand outward from forehead in a small arc, like a salute.

signs.hand_position: Hand open, palm facing outward.
signs.movement: Small upward movement of the hand.

signs.hand_position: Hand open, palm facing outward.
signs.movement: Move hand side to side like waving.

signs.meaning: Wishing someone well at the start of the day.
signs.hand_position: Flat hand at chin, then arc down to stomach.
signs.movement: Move hand from chin downward in an arc.
signs.example_sentence: Good morning! Did you sleep well?

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at chin, then move to bent hand at forehead.
signs.movement: Chin to forehead, closing fingers like going to sleep.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand touching chin, fingers pointing forward.
signs.movement: Move hand forward and slightly downward from chin.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand on chest, moving in circular motion.
signs.movement: Rub chest in circular motion with flat hand.

signs.hand_position: Fist hand, rub in circular motion on chest.
signs.movement: Circular rubbing motion on chest with fist.
signs.example_sentence: I am sorry for being late.

signs.meaning: Polite way to get attention or apologize.
signs.hand_position: A-handshape, brush twice on inner edge of non-dominant hand.
signs.movement: Brush A-handshape twice on palm of other hand.
signs.example_sentence: Excuse me, can I get through?

signs.hand_position: Closed fist, nod up and down like a head nod.
signs.movement: Move fist up and down in nodding motion.

signs.hand_position: Index and middle fingers together, thumb touching them. Open like scissors.
signs.movement: Tap index and middle fingers to thumb, then open.
signs.example_sentence: No, I do not want that.

signs.hand_position: Both hands with palms up, alternate moving up and down.
signs.movement: Move both open hands alternately up and down.

signs.hand_position: B-handshape from chin, move outward and down.
signs.movement: Move B-hand outward from chin in arc.

signs.hand_position: Open hand, thumb touching chin.
signs.movement: Tap thumb on chin twice.

signs.hand_position: Open hand, thumb touching forehead.
signs.movement: Tap thumb on forehead twice.

signs.hand_position: F-hands touching at tips, then circle outward.
signs.movement: Circle both F-hands outward from center.

signs.hand_position: L-hands: one at forehead (boy), one at chest (same).
signs.movement: Sign BOY + SAME combined.

signs.hand_position: L-hands: one at chin (girl), one at chest (same).
signs.movement: Sign GIRL + SAME combined.

signs.hand_position: Arms cradled, rock back and forth.
signs.movement: Rock arms back and forth like holding a baby.

signs.hand_position: Pat chest twice with open hand, then show height.
signs.movement: Pat chest, then indicate small height with hand.

signs.hand_position: Sign MOTHER, then bounce hand upward twice.
signs.movement: MOTHER sign with bouncing motion upward.

signs.hand_position: Sign FATHER, then bounce hand upward twice.
signs.movement: FATHER sign with bouncing motion upward.

signs.hand_position: H-hand tapping on opposite wrist twice.
signs.movement: Tap H-hand on wrist twice.
signs.example_sentence: I need to go to the hospital.

signs.hand_position: D-hand tapping on inner wrist twice.
signs.movement: Tap D-hand on inner wrist twice.
signs.example_sentence: The doctor will see you now.

signs.hand_position: Middle finger touches left palm, then twist wrist.
signs.movement: Touch palm and twist wrist.

signs.hand_position: Middle fingers of both hands at stomach, move outward.
signs.movement: Touch stomach with both middle fingers, then pull outward.

signs.hand_position: Index fingers pointing at each other, twist in opposite directions.
signs.movement: Twist index fingers in opposite directions near affected area.
signs.example_sentence: I have pain in my head.

signs.hand_position: Right hand on top of left fist, lift upward.
signs.movement: Lift right hand from left fist upward.

signs.hand_position: Both E-hands, palms facing body, move outward.
signs.movement: Move both E-hands outward from chest.

signs.hand_position: N-hand at shoulder, tap twice.
signs.movement: Tap N-hand on shoulder twice.

signs.hand_position: Fingers wiggling upward from palm, like flames.
signs.movement: Wiggle fingers upward from open palm.

signs.hand_position: C-hand at chest, tap twice.
signs.movement: Tap C-hand on chest twice (from badge shape).

signs.hand_position: One hand flat, palm facing out, move forward sharply.
signs.movement: Push flat palm forward firmly.

signs.hand_position: X-hands crossed, move apart sharply.
signs.movement: Cross X-hands then pull apart quickly.

signs.hand_position: W-hand at chin, tap index finger.
signs.movement: Tap W-hand on chin.

signs.hand_position: Fingertips together, touch mouth twice.
signs.movement: Touch fingertips to mouth twice.

signs.hand_position: O-hand to mouth, close and open.
signs.movement: Bring O-hand to mouth and open.

signs.hand_position: C-hand at mouth, tilt back like drinking from cup.
signs.movement: Tilt C-hand at mouth like drinking.

signs.hand_position: C-hand at stomach, move down in circular motion.
signs.movement: Circle C-hand down from stomach.

signs.hand_position: Both hands slice imaginary bread with knife motion.
signs.movement: Sawing motion with both hands like slicing bread.

signs.hand_position: Squeeze imaginary udder with both hands alternately.
signs.movement: Alternate squeezing motion with both fists.

signs.hand_position: F-hands, one on top of other, twist like grinding coffee.
signs.movement: Twist F-hands in grinding motion.

signs.hand_position: Knuckle of index finger at cheek, twist.
signs.movement: Twist knuckle on cheek like checking apple firmness.

signs.hand_position: Index finger extended upward.
signs.movement: Hold index finger up.

signs.hand_position: Index and middle fingers extended.
signs.movement: Hold two fingers up.

signs.hand_position: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended.
signs.movement: Hold three fingers up.

signs.hand_position: All four fingers extended, thumb tucked.
signs.movement: Hold four fingers up with thumb tucked.

signs.hand_position: All five fingers extended (open hand).
signs.movement: Hold open hand with all fingers spread.

signs.hand_position: Shake A-handshape (thumb out) with twisting motion.
signs.movement: Shake A-handshape with thumb flicking.

signs.hand_position: C-handshape, palm facing signer, move in small arc.
signs.movement: Move C-hand in small arc.

signs.hand_position: Fist with thumb on side of fingers.
signs.movement: Hold fist steady.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand, fingers together, thumb tucked.
signs.movement: Hold palm facing outward.

signs.hand_position: Hand curved in C shape.
signs.movement: Hold C shape steady.

signs.hand_position: Index finger up, thumb and middle finger touch to form circle.
signs.movement: Hold D-handshape steady.

signs.hand_position: All fingers curled in, thumb across fingertips.
signs.movement: Hold E-handshape steady.

signs.hand_position: Index and thumb touch, other fingers extended up.
signs.movement: Hold OK-sign with other fingers up.

signs.hand_position: Pinky finger extended, other fingers closed into fist.
signs.movement: Hold pinky up.

signs.hand_position: Index finger and thumb extended in L shape.
signs.movement: Hold L-handshape steady.

signs.hand_position: Crossed fingers: index over middle.
signs.movement: Hold crossed fingers steady.

signs.hand_position: Fist with thumb over fingers.
signs.movement: Hold fist with thumb wrapped over.

signs.hand_position: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended, thumb and pinky tucked.
signs.movement: Hold three middle fingers up.

signs.hand_position: Pinky and thumb extended, other fingers closed.
signs.movement: Hold hang-loose sign.

signs.hand_position: Both hands with bent fingers, palms up, move outward.
signs.movement: Move both hands outward from chest.

signs.hand_position: I-L-Y handshape: pinky, index, thumb extended.
signs.movement: Hold I-L-Y handshape at chest, move outward.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand from chin, move forward and down.
signs.movement: Move flat hand from chin outward.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand under chin, flip outward.
signs.movement: Flip flat hand outward from under chin.

signs.hand_position: Thumbs up at chest, move slightly upward.
signs.movement: Give thumbs up.

signs.hand_position: Index fingers pointing outward, shake side to side.
signs.movement: Shake both index fingers side to side.

signs.hand_position: Index fingers extended, palms up, move both hands outward.
signs.movement: Move both open hands outward with questioning expression.

signs.hand_position: L-hand at chin, move outward in arc.
signs.movement: Move L-hand from chin outward.

signs.hand_position: Index finger at forehead, flick outward.
signs.movement: Touch forehead with index finger, then flick outward.

signs.hand_position: Both hands with bent fingers, palms up, alternate moving up and down.
signs.movement: Move both hands alternately up and down.

signs.hand_position: H-hands: tap index and middle fingers of both hands together twice.
signs.movement: Tap H-hands together twice.

signs.hand_position: Flat hands together, then move outward in arc.
signs.movement: Press palms together then arc outward.

signs.hand_position: Clap hands together twice (like clapping erasers).
signs.movement: Clap open hands together twice.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at forehead, pull down to palm of other hand.
signs.movement: Move hand from forehead down to other palm.

signs.hand_position: Sign LEARN + PERSON (flat hand down from chin).
signs.movement: Learn sign followed by person indicator.

signs.hand_position: Sign LEARN + PERSON.
signs.movement: Learn sign followed by person indicator.

signs.hand_position: Open hands together, then open like a book.
signs.movement: Open hands from together to apart like opening book.

signs.hand_position: I-handshape, move like writing on palm of other hand.
signs.movement: Make writing motion on palm.
signs.example_sentence: I need to write a letter.

signs.hand_position: S-hands, tap together twice.
signs.movement: Tap S-hands together twice.

signs.hand_position: Rub thumb and fingers together in circular motion.
signs.movement: Rub fingertips together like counting coins.

signs.hand_position: S-hands at chest, move in steering motion.
signs.movement: Move S-hands like steering a wheel.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at mouth, then move to palm of other hand.
signs.movement: Touch mouth then place hand on other palm.

signs.meaning: To move from one place to another.
signs.hand_position: Index fingers together, move forward in arc.
signs.movement: Move both index fingers forward together.

signs.hand_position: Both hands beckoning inward.
signs.movement: Beckon with both hands toward yourself.

signs.hand_position: Both index and middle fingers walking on palm of other hand.
signs.movement: Walk two fingers across palm.

signs.hand_position: B-hands at chest, move forward while shaking.
signs.movement: Move B-hands forward with slight shake.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at chest, move upward in circular motion.
signs.movement: Circle flat hand upward from chest.

signs.hand_position: Both hands at face, move downward.
signs.movement: Move both hands down from face.

signs.hand_position: Claw hands at stomach, move upward sharply.
signs.movement: Pull claw hands up from stomach.

signs.hand_position: Cross arms over chest, hug yourself.
signs.movement: Cross arms and hug chest.

signs.hand_position: Both hands at chest, move outward while opening fingers.
signs.movement: Flap hands outward from chest like startled.

signs.hand_position: Flat hands at chest, droop downward.
signs.movement: Let hands droop down from chest.

signs.hand_position: Pat thigh, then snap fingers or clap.
signs.movement: Pat leg then snap fingers (calling a dog).

signs.hand_position: Fingers spread at cheeks, pull outward like whiskers.
signs.movement: Pull fingers from cheeks outward like whiskers.

signs.hand_position: Thumbs at armpits, flap hands like wings.
signs.movement: Flap hands at sides like bird wings.

signs.hand_position: One hand flat, wiggle side to side like a fish.
signs.movement: Wiggle flat hand side to side.

signs.hand_position: Index finger at lip, pull down.
signs.movement: Brush index finger down from bottom lip.

signs.hand_position: B-handshape, shake side to side.
signs.movement: Shake B-hand side to side.

signs.hand_position: G-handshape, shake side to side.
signs.movement: Shake G-hand side to side.

signs.hand_position: Index finger across forehead from left to right.
signs.movement: Draw line across forehead with index finger.

signs.hand_position: W-hand at chest, pull outward.
signs.movement: Pull W-hand outward from chest.

signs.hand_position: Both flat hands at chest, move downward together.
signs.movement: Move both flat hands down from chest.

signs.hand_position: A-hand at cheek, move forward and arc down.
signs.movement: Move A-hand from cheek forward in arc.

signs.hand_position: A-hand at cheek, move backward and arc down.
signs.movement: Move A-hand from cheek backward in arc.

signs.hand_position: Y-hands, drop downward sharply.
signs.movement: Drop both Y-hands downward.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at stomach, arc up to chest.
signs.movement: Arc flat hand upward from stomach to chest.
signs.example_sentence: I wake up in the morning.

signs.hand_position: Bent hand over face, close fingers.
signs.movement: Bend hand over face and close fingers like night falling.
signs.example_sentence: The stars come out at night.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at temple, move outward in small arc.
signs.movement: Move flat hand outward from temple.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at chin, move forward and down.
signs.movement: Move flat hand from chin forward.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at mouth, move down to chest.
signs.movement: Move flat hand from mouth to chest.

signs.hand_position: Both hands wave with palms outward.
signs.movement: Wave both hands with palms facing outward.

signs.hand_position: Flat hand at lips, move forward.
signs.movement: Move flat hand from lips forward.

phrases.description: A common conversational greeting. In natural ASL, multi-sign phrases are produced as a sequence rather than as one literal English word.
A greeting used at the start of the day.
A polite introduction when meeting someone for the first time.
A casual farewell indicating a future meeting.
A question used to learn someone’s name.
A phrase used when introducing your name.
A phrase for communicating that clarification is needed.
